page: Microsoft Azure L4aos_v5 is a virtual machine instance belonging to the Laosv5 family, running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It features 4 dedicated vCPUs based on an AMD processor with x86_64 architecture. The instance is equipped with 32.0 GB of system memory, providing a ratio of 8.0 GB of RAM per vCPU.

A key feature of the L4aos_v5 instance is its bundled local storage, consisting of 2880 GB of NVMe SSD capacity. It is also Premium Storage capable, allowing for high-performance external disk attachments. The instance does not include any complimentary public IPv4 addresses and does not feature any dedicated GPUs.

Given the high ratio of local NVMe SSD storage and memory relative to the 4 dedicated vCPUs, this instance offers high resource density for data-intensive workloads. It is qualitatively cost-efficient for scenarios requiring rapid local read and write operations without the overhead of external storage arrays. The hardware profile is suited for relational databases, NoSQL databases, caching layers, and memory-intensive data processing tasks.
